author: (A. d'Orbigny, 1841)

note.en: A barrel-shaped bubble snail under 5 mm, the best documented of its group here: six specimens from 8 to 14.5 m between Cahuita, Manzanillo and the Gandoca to Sixaola stretch. Too small to notice without a sample of sand.
note.es: Una babosa burbuja en forma de barril de menos de 5 mm, la mejor documentada de su grupo aquí: seis ejemplares de 8 a 14,5 m entre Cahuita, Manzanillo y el tramo de Gandoca a Sixaola. Es demasiado pequeña para notarla sin una muestra de arena.

evidence: GBIF: 6 preserved specimens in the region (INBio Atta collection, 1998 to 2003)
WoRMS lists it for the Costa Rican Caribbean

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection), Gandoca to Limón
